pages.text: Earth is our home planet. Earth spins slowly all the time, even when we are sleeping.
Earth does not stand still. It turns in place like a slow, gentle top.
When part of Earth faces the Sun, it becomes daytime in that place.
As Earth keeps spinning, your side slowly turns away from the Sun. Night begins, and the Moon and stars come out.
Day and night happen again and again because Earth keeps spinning without stopping.
One full spin of Earth takes one whole day. That is why days are about the same length.
While one side has day, the other side has night. Different places have different times.
Even when clouds cover the sky, Earth is still spinning and making day and night.
Earth has been spinning for a very long time, helping life follow a steady rhythm.
At bedtime, we remember: Earth spins every day, making daytime and nighttime for everyone.
